description:
List the enriched SpiderGate model catalog: identity + spec + authored copy + benchmarks + per-provider price/latency + reference links + evals aggregate, with provenance on every sourced field.
Use "fields" (CSV) to narrow the payload for concrete-model selection, e.g. fields="capabilities,pricing,per_provider,evals" — recognised sections: capabilities, context, max_output, pricing, tier, descriptions, dates, tags, aliases, per_provider, benchmarks, links, evals, category_scores. With no "fields", the five child sections (per_provider, benchmarks, links, evals, category_scores) are all returned. Read-only, not metered.

TO CALL A MODEL, SEND ITS `call_as`. Every row carries `call_as`: the exact `model` string to pass to gate_chat for that row right now, or null. Null means the SHARED POOL cannot serve that row now. It does not cover your brand's own unshared keys: a model only your own key can serve reads null here (GET /api/gate/v1/subscriptions answers for your own keys; its rows carry their own `call_as`). Do not send a row's `id` because a filter returned the row: a Codex row's `id` is refused, and the row is called as codex/<model_id>, which is what its `call_as` holds while the gateway holds a pooled Codex seat for a model it still offers. `call_as` is present under every "fields" projection. Each gateway process reads its own key state, so `call_as` can differ between two reads for a moment.
`servable` is per ROW: true when a pooled key may serve that model on that row (not hidden, no Codex row taking the same id first). It stays false for Codex, so decide on `call_as`, not on `servable` or `is_configured`.

configured_only.description: Only rows whose stored is_configured flag is true. A saved flag, not a live check: a returned row can have call_as null, and a Codex row's id is refused. To call a row, send its call_as.

include_hidden.description: Include models hidden from the public catalog.

name: gate_catalog_list
